text:
Priya Patel: Hey team, two quick onboarding things I noticed in my first week: 1) I made an HSA election but it still shows $0 in the benefits portal contribution summary, and 2) I submitted a dependent daycare FSA election but can't see it reflected on my W-4 preview or paystub. Also my direct deposit was accepted but I haven't seen a pre-note confirmation. Who do I ping?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Priya! Congrats on joining. Short answers: HSA/FSA should show once carrier sync and payroll pick them up (can be a cycle or two), and direct deposit pre-note varies by bank (usually 11 days). Sanya and Liam can check the backend.

Sanya (Benefits): Looking into your HSA and Dependent Care FSA. I see both enrollments as "Completed" on 2024-06-18 but carrier sync to the HSA custodian sometimes lags. Priya, which HSA plan did you pick (High Deductible or HSA+Buyup)?

Priya Patel: Chose "HSA (HDHP) - Employee only" and set $150/mo. For the Dependent Care FSA I picked $200/mo.

Sanya (Benefits): Thanks. HSA enrollment completed but the custodian report batch processed 06/19 after payroll cutoff. Your first paycheck won't show the HSA debit until the 06/30 run; the FSA should appear on 06/30 as well if payroll receives the file. I'll flag for expedited sync if payroll needs it sooner.

Liam (Payroll): Confirming: our payroll file import from Benefits was received 06/19 23:40 UTC, but it hit the bank cutoff. We'll apply HSA + DepCare on the next cycle (06/30). If you need a retroactive adjustment for anything missed in June we can do a manual payroll adjustment, but it's taxable treatment differs. DM me if you want that.

Priya Patel: OK that makes sense. Re: W-4 preview: I updated it to 0 allowances + extra $50 withholding. The W-4 preview page still shows the old withholding. Is that separate?

Liam (Payroll): The W-4 we store in Workday; the preview page in the benefits portal is cached. If you updated in Workday after first sync, it may take a day. I show your W-4 effective 06/17 with extra $50 so payroll will use that for the 06/30 run.

Priya Patel: Thanks. One more: my bank pre-note shows "Pending" in the payroll portal. Is that normal and when should I expect the deposit verification?

Liam (Payroll): Pre-note typically resolves in 1-3 business days. If it shows pending after 5 business days, ping me. Also confirm routing number ends with 4 digits (do not share full number in channel).

Priya Patel: Confirmed last 4 are 4321.

BenefitsBot: Enrollment files processed: HSA (employee only) - queued for payroll; Dependent Care FSA - queued. Ticket #B-2119 created for expedited sync.

Sanya (Benefits): I created ticket B-2119 requesting the HSA custodian push; no action needed from you.

Priya Patel: Awesome, thank you all. One tiny policy question: if my spouse is later added as a dependent for benefits does that change the FSA eligibility for dependent-care vs flexible spending?

Ava (People Ops): Good question. Dependent Care FSA is for eligible care expenses for qualifying dependents (e.g., children under 13 or a dependent adult who lives with you). Adding a spouse as a health/dependent on medical/dental doesn't change Dependent Care FSA rules. If you later add a spouse to medical, that affects medical premiums and HSA eligibility (HSA limits change for family coverage)  so you'll need to re-evaluate contribution limits. Sanya can advise on HSA limit changes.

Sanya (Benefits): Right  for 2024 HSA family limit is higher than individual. If you switch to family coverage we'd recommend adjusting contributions to stay within IRS limits.

Priya Patel: Great, thanks. I'll wait for the 06/30 paycheck then. Appreciate the rapid help! :raised_hands:
